actionable_findings.topic: Travel is worker time, not an independent cash debit
actionable_findings.article_locator: From a crop loop to a competitive farm, first paragraph
actionable_findings.current_text: Winning means finishing with more banked cash after inputs, feed, wages and travel have been paid for.
actionable_findings.suggested_text: Winning means finishing with more banked cash after inputs, feed and wages; travel consumes the worker time needed to produce and deliver it.
actionable_findings.reason: Movement action spends a turn. There is no direct movement-price charge in these rules.

actionable_findings.topic: The evaluator itself was an evolving research instrument
actionable_findings.article_locator: How the loop was designed, after three evidence types or in technical appendix
actionable_findings.suggested_text: The opponent models needed validation too. Early reconstructions copied an elite farm composition onto our own executor, which could make local matchups misleading. Later amendments compared reconstructed models with public executable policies and separated market-price feedback from genuine replay-model error. Those were historical instrument changes, not evidence that one benchmark was permanently authoritative.
actionable_findings.reason: Current prose covers source freezing and three test categories but omits documented major changes to calibration/promotion instruments. Do not copy old model-derived Elo estimates as achieved live results.
